integrity_notes: Proof reconstructs the weighted primitive-necklace identity and geometric matching, proves singularity uniqueness and strict concavity, and is accompanied by independent rational exhaustive tests. The public finite tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only expectation and its fixed-positive-bias asymptotic are proved, not concentration, a typical count or uniformity in source degeneracy. The exact uniform finite-length expectation was previously published and is not a novelty claim. Global uniqueness in unindexed literature has not been established.
title: Bias-sensitive Lyndon subsequence growth and a sharp uniform-source optimizer
